messages:
Ajay: quick heads-up: noticed a small but consistent billing blip tied to sampled background-embed requests that get truncated before any token is produced. seems we record provisional rows and later UI multiplies them by 1/sample_rate.
Maria: seriously? are we surfacing sampled estimates as real charges in the route dashboard?
Ajay: yup. router-sidecar writes provisional ledger rows as soon as it dispatches the sampled job. if client cancels during the initial handshake we still have a provisional entry that never flips to confirmed.
Kei: can you drop the logs?
Ajay: snippet:
```
router(sidecar): dispatch sample id=sx-42 route=bg-embed sample_rate=0.05
embed-worker: accept sx-42, predicted_tokens=6
router(sidecar): client disconnected during setup, mark truncated
ledger: insert provisional {route:bg-embed, tokens:6, sample_rate:0.05}
```
Paul: that's the issue: billing pipeline expands tokens by 1/0.05 = 20 for sampled exposure. 6 -> 120 visible tokens. since provisional never resolves, dashboard shows a spike and finance sees it in exports.
Maria: that's bad. customers will escalate. support will be confused. :grimacing: we need clearer UI and ledger semantics.
Kei: two levers: (A) prevent scaling until confirm (store raw_sampled_tokens + sample_rate) or (B) keep existing numbers but reconcile stale provisionals aggressively.
Ajay: I prefer A for correctness. Minimal internal API change: router sets headers X-Sample-Rate and X-Truncated and ledger accepts sampled_count and rate instead of pre-scaled tokens.
Paul: ledger schema expects integer tokens currently. migrating to sampled metadata will be a small migration but safer. alternatively add a metadata column meta_sample (json string) to avoid breaking queries.
Maria: UI changes: show both "estimated exposure" and "billed tokens" columns. also surface sample_rate and truncated flag. support triage depends on this clarity.
Kei: routing retries complicate this: if router retries the dispatch on transient error we may write duplicate provisional rows. need dedupe keys tied to client_req_id + sample_nonce.
Ajay: agreed. router should generate a sample_nonce for each sample dispatch and attach it; ledger should dedupe on (client_req_id, sample_nonce).
Paul: operationally, we also need a cleanup job: sweep provisional rows older than 10 minutes and auto-reverse when route==bg-embed and no confirmation seen. don't auto-reverse for interactive streams/toolcalls because they may confirm later.
Maria: finance asked for a CSV of anomalous provisional spikes last 72h. can we generate that once we have a filter?
billing-bot: alert: provisional_sample_rows for bg-embed increased by 18% in the last hour.
Kei: action list from me: 1) patch router to send X-Sample-Rate + sample_nonce, 2) ledger migration plan (meta_sample column), 3) dedupe on sample_nonce.
Paul: I'll change the console backend to stop summing scaled tokens by default and instead show raw vs estimate. put behind flag `ui.show_sample_metadata`.
Maria: I'll draft a support runbook explaining how to read the new dashboard and how to run the finance export. include examples of when a reversal would happen.
Ajay: I'll prototype the reconciler job and add metrics: stale_provisional_count and provisional_reversals_per_min.
Kei: timeline?
Paul: ledger migration + router header: 2d. console query changes + feature flag: 3d. reconciler + metrics: 2d. runbook: 1d. staggered rollout over a week.
Maria: please include unit tests for the sampling math so we don't accidentally double-scale in some aggregation step.
Ajay: will do. thanks all. :thumbsup:
billing-bot: created task FIN-EXPORT-829 for finance export request.
